*made ... melt* is rule 44's causative: the second verb is the complement carrying מָסָה's lexeme and takes the head, the unit discontinuous around the object (rule 25).
*the heart of the people* is rule 29's arthrous case — the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct לֵב a supplied one; nothing is fronted.
